annotations.title: Get rank tracker newcomers and fast climbers

description: Newcomers and fast climbers for a tracker's OWN domain, over a window. `newlyRanking` is keywords that started ranking during the window (no earlier position, or an earlier position of null). `fastClimbers` is keywords that ranked at both ends of the window and gained at least `minGain` positions. FREE: database only. No SEO data provider is called and no credits are spent. THIS IS NOT COMPETITOR DISCOVERY. No corpus of undeclared domains exists in this codebase to discover a newcomer domain from — a rank check only ever persists positions for the target domain and the already-tracked competitor list; every other domain in a fetched SERP is read and discarded. Do not describe a `newlyRanking` entry as a 'new competitor' or 'newly discovered domain' — it is a keyword the TRACKED domain itself started ranking for, nothing about a competitor. `newlyRanking` entries always have `gain: null` — there is no earlier position to measure a gain from, and `minGain` never filters them.

configId.description: Rank tracker config ID. Call get_rank_tracker without a trackerId to list the project's trackers and their IDs.

minGain.description: Positions a keyword must have gained to count as a fast climber, 1–100. Defaults to 5. Does not affect newlyRanking, which has no earlier position to measure a gain from.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

sinceDays.description: How many days back to look, 1–730. Defaults to 365.

name: get_rank_movers
